name: May
objective: Keep April's buyers (target ≥55% renewing at next expiry vs 24.5% for 2026 anniversary-code buyers) and use Mother's Day for duo acquisition.
strategy:
The Afterparty.

Commercial job: Keep April's buyers (target ≥55% renewing at next expiry vs 24.5% for 2026 anniversary-code buyers) and use Mother's Day for duo acquisition.

Newcomer: Mum's the Word (“Bring your mum. You both get 20% off and a trainer to yourselves.”). Duo trials with a booked second class convert best; Mother's Day gives the reason.

Newcomer: The Second Date (Evergreen) (“Your second class is booked before you leave.”). The default journey for every first-timer outside a campaign.

Winback: A Class for Mum (“Come back at 20% off, and bring your mum for free.”). On-theme, and the gift class is a warm new lead.

Renewal: Afterparty Pricing (“Show up in May, and your next renewal costs less.”). April buyers who attend in May are the ones who renew (2026 anniversary-code buyers renewed at only 24.5%). The discount is earned by attendance, not handed out.
notes:
Moment: The Afterparty: every April buyer gets a 30-day plan — a week-1 call, and 8 classes in May unlocks a hosted Afterparty class and a trainer progress check.
Build: new clients 42 buyers × ₹12,000 = ₹5.0L; reactivation 36 × ₹11,468 = ₹4.1L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.2L; renewals ₹18.1L. First visits needed 140 vs 118 last year (1.19×); CRM leads needed 280 vs 127 last year.

Set up A Class for Mum in Momence (1–16 May.): A 12-class pack at 20% off (₹15,750) — a free class for your mum (or any mum you choose).

Set up Afterparty Pricing in Momence (All May.): Next renewal: 3 Months at 20% off (₹46,284) or 1 Month at 10% off (₹18,215) — unlocked by booking 8 classes in May, plus a hosted Afterparty class and a trainer progress check.
Brief the team on the 4 May offers, who each one is for, and the no-stacking rule; print the offer cards for the desk.
Launch Mum's the Word to A mother and a family member, both new.
Launch The Second Date (Evergreen) to First-time clients.
Launch A Class for Mum to Lapsed clients.
Launch Afterparty Pricing to April buyers and May renewers.
Run the month's moment: The Afterparty: every April buyer gets a 30-day plan — a week-1 call, and 8 classes in May unlocks a hosted Afterparty class and a trainer progress check.

Weekly check: Mum's the Word: Duos trialled; both-buy rate. | The Second Date (Evergreen): Second-visit share (target 55%). | A Class for Mum: Gift classes booked; mums converting. | Afterparty Pricing: April cohort attendance in May (target 8+); next-expiry renewal (target 55%).
Mid-month review against ₹30.5L: by the 15th aim for about half of 217 renewals, 36 reactivations and 42 new buyers (140 first visits). Push the lists, not a deeper discount.
Close May: tag every redemption by offer, record results, and brief June's offers.
